name: Data Parallelism (DDP)
description: Replicate model on each GPU, split data, average gradients via all-reduce.

name: Fully Sharded Data Parallel
description: PyTorch's ZeRO-like implementation. Shards model, gradients, and optimizer states across GPUs.

name: DeepSpeed ZeRO
description: Microsoft's sharded data parallelism. Stages 1-3 progressively shard more state.

name: Tensor Parallelism
description: Split individual layer operations across GPUs. Requires fast interconnect (NVLink).

name: Pipeline Parallelism
description: Split model layers across GPUs in sequence. Different micro-batches on different GPUs.
